title: Business Intelligence Engineer
description:
* Operate and continuously improve the CARS/BI backend within the global Enterprise Data

Warehouse and Business Intelligence platform, ensuring system stability, continuous data
  
  
loading, and the timely delivery of business-critical reports.
  
  

* Own the underlying data foundation — SQL pipelines, relational data models, and data

warehouse structures — that internal reporting teams and global Data Management initiatives
  
  
depend on, and act as 1st and 2nd level support for internal customers such as SCM and
  
  
Sales.
  
  

* The role is needed to secure daily BI availability in the Asian time zone, reduce the risk of late

or incorrect reporting, and add dedicated database and ETL capacity to the global BI team,
  
  
including support to the Data Center team on infrastructure-related issues.
  
  
Tasks and Responsibilities
  
  
Describe the tasks and responsibilities in more detail. Use bullet points.
  
  

* Operate, monitor, and maintain the CARS/BI data integration and data processing workflows,

ensuring continuous data loading and stable daily business operations.
  
  

* Provide 1st and 2nd level support for CARS/BI, including user support, incident handling, and

root-cause analysis of data issues.
  
  

* Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL-based data pipelines and transformations within the

Enterprise Data Warehouse.
  
  

* Design and maintain relational data models and data warehouse structures for CARS BI.
* Integrate data from ERP and other enterprise systems into the BI backend.
* Ensure data consistency, integrity, and performance at database level, including query tuning

and database efficiency improvements.
  
  

* Administer the BI technical environment and contribute to its continuous enhancement as part

of a global team.
  
  

* Support reporting teams by providing structured, reliable datasets and safeguarding the timely

delivery of business-critical reports.
  
  

* Contribute to global Data Management initiatives, with a focus on Master Data Management

and the development of a Common Data Model within the Business Integration Platform.
  
  

* Collaborate with the Data Center team to resolve infrastructure-related issues affecting BI

availability.
  
  
Education and Experience
  
  
Specify what level of education is needed (secondary school, technical school, university,
  
  
master, PHD, etc).
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Engineering (BE/B.Tech) or equivalent in Computer Science, Information
  
  
Technology, or a comparable technical field.
  
  
Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience in Business Intelligence, data warehousing, or
  
  
database development, including hands-on SQL and ETL work in an enterprise environment.
  
  
Experience supporting business users in a global or multi-time-zone IT organization is an advantage.
  
  

* Knowledge about either BI platforms (e.g. IBM Cognos BI suite) or ETL tools (e.g. Informatica

PowerCenter)
  
  

* Database, data modeling and SQL (preferred Oracle PLSQL)
* Good analytical and communication skills
* Teamplayer
* English
* Strong hands-on experience with SQL (advanced level)
* Solid understanding of relational databases and data warehouse concepts
* Experience with ETL tools and database technologies (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, SAP BW,

Informatica or similar)
  
  

* Performance tuning and query optimization skills
* Structured, detail-oriented, and quality-focused working style
* Good understanding of enterprise data flows (SAP/CARS is a plus)

title: Fleet Performance Superintendent
description:
As a
 **Fleet Performance Superintendent** 
 at
 **BSM,** 
 you will be responsible to monitor and provide timely advice for improving the Operational Performance of the fully managed fleet using all available resources for optimising efficiency, reliability and competitiveness.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitors and supports the Company’s drive towards its goals in technical reliability and energy efficient operation, thereby assisting its Clients achieve and maintain their competitive edge.
* Helps develop the Company’s proprietary software platform using existing methodologies as directed by supervisor.
* Monitors and refines modelling methods so as to ensure the software platform always maintains BSM’s lead among competitors.
* Explores software and hardware solutions that can improve the reporting, modelling and analysis quality.
* Ensures the implementation of the performance monitoring system across the fleet.
* Monitors adherence of the ships to predefined reporting frequency and quality standards. Provides guidance and support to the ship’s staff as required.
* Provides support and guidance to the SMC wherever retrofitting of equipment is required and follows up the installation \& implementation process.
* Provides expert advice to the responsible SMC based on the performance analysis results.
* Provides regular reports to Fleet Management.
* Provides suggestions for expanding the performance monitoring portfolio.
* Supports the SMCs with Client specific performance monitoring systems, issuing formal guidance wherever required.
* Supports the COO office team with Analysis Reports related to the fleet’s performance.
* Supports S.M.C. and Clients with the selection of Makers at the newbuilding stage by providing advice based on documented performance records.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* MSc in Marine Engineering and/or Naval Architecture or equivalent
* Preferably 1 year in the technical department of a ship management/owningcompany,shipyard,researchfacilityorClassification society
* Experience with model tests, shop tests and/or sea trials considered a big advantage
* Minimum of five years’ sailing experience


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Very strong analytical skills
* High IT proficiency, preferably with programming knowledge
* Very good project management and organisational skills
* Open to new ideas and keen to challenge convention
* High level of organisation, attention to detail, and problem\-solving ability
* Team\-oriented, proactive, and safety\-focused approach


**Why You Should Join Us!**
 We offer a supportive environment, competitive compensation, and meaningful opportunities. By joining us, you will enjoy:
   

  

* On\-the\-job training.
* First\-hand exposure to the growing maritime technological industry.
* Diverse workforce.
* Technology\-driven company.
* Be a part of the ever\-growing Schulte group family!
